EmailTemplate.subject: Flywire Forward's keynote speaker is...
EmailTemplate.textOnly: And our keynote speaker is... Dominique Dawes! ‌ The past year and a half have not been easy, to say the least. And with the Tokyo Games still on our mind, who better than an Olympian to give us the inspiration we need to keep moving forward <[[https://hopin.com/events/flywire-forward?ref=2e99c0b21721]]>? On September 16th at 12:20pm ET, Dominique Dawes, three-time Olympian and Olympic Gold Medalist, will take the virtual stage at Flywire Forward <[[https://hopin.com/events/flywire-forward?ref=2e99c0b21721]]> to discuss her personal motto – Determination, Dedication & Desire: Building an Olympic Mindset. ‌ The only way to hear from Dominique is live at the event. Grab your free ticket and get ready to stick the landing with us!
